propositions: A single criterion's LLMBudgetExhaustedError during evidence gathering currently propagates and aborts the entire recovery, discarding all partial evidence collected across other criteria
The evidence loop treats per-criterion budget exhaustion as fatal to aggregate recovery when it should only mark that criterion unverifiable-within-bounds and continue with remaining criteria
Budget exhaustion from RunawayToolLoopError and token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError must be caught and converted to content-free placeholder entries rather than failing the whole recovery

Recovery should only raise CompletionRecoveryError when zero criteria produce evidence; if at least one criterion gathers evidence, the finalizer must receive all N entries including exhausted placeholders

Placeholder evidence entries must contain only the failure class name and numeric counters, never presentable as affirmative evidence, so the finalizer correctly scores exhausted criteria as unmet/indeterminate
